findings.title: Grounding Agent Stages and Commits User Dirty Workspace Files
findings.description: GroundingAgent.run writes walking skeleton files directly into params.repoRoot and runs git.addAllExcluding without checking for existing uncommitted user files, forcibly staging user uncommitted work into automated grounding commits.
findings.proposedTest: tests/git-dirty-workspace-grounding.test.ts: Create dirty file in repoRoot, trigger GroundingAgent, assert dirty file is untracked and uncommitted.
findings.remediation: Check statusPorcelain before writing files. Abort or isolate skeleton creation in an explicit worktree if dirty.

findings.title: Unconditional Lock Release Deletes Active Foreign Locks
findings.description: acquireDurableLock release callback unconditionally deletes lockPath directory without verifying lock ownership, allowing a process that exceeds lock timeout to delete a newly acquired lock of another process.
findings.proposedTest: tests/run-store-lock-ownership.test.ts: Acquire lock, force timeout takeover by process B, trigger process A release, verify process B lock directory remains intact.
findings.remediation: Inspect owner.json inside lockPath in release callback. Only delete lockPath if PID and acquiredAt timestamp match.

findings.title: Unsupervised Process Spawning & Secret Leakage in Planning V2
findings.description: Planning V2 CLI processes are spawned with unfiltered process.env and bypass supervisedSpawnFn process supervisor registration, leaking secrets and escaping lifecycle tracking.
findings.proposedTest: tests/security-planning-env.test.ts: Spawn planning process, verify process.env contains only allowlisted keys and process is registered in LiveProcessRegistry.
findings.remediation: Use buildAgentEnvironment() for environment variables and call the supervised spawn wrapper.

findings.title: Path Traversal & Boundary Check Bypass in Scope Enforcement
findings.description: Scope path normalization does not validate ../ path traversal sequences or verify that resolved paths stay strictly within the target worktree root.
findings.proposedTest: tests/scope-path-traversal.test.ts: Pass ../../etc/passwd to scope checker, assert access denied.
findings.remediation: Resolve path against worktree root using path.resolve and verify path.startsWith(worktreeRoot).

findings.title: DAG Cycle Validation Omits ArtifactRequirement Dependencies
findings.description: validateGraphRevision checks parentage hierarchy cycles but omits ArtifactRequirement consumer-producer cycle validation, permitting circular artifact dependencies.
findings.proposedTest: tests/task-graph-artifact-cycles.test.ts: Build circular ArtifactRequirement graph, call validateGraphRevision, assert cyclic artifact error.
findings.remediation: Construct explicit adjacency matrix of artifact producer-consumer edges in validateGraphRevision and run Kahn's algorithm cycle detection.

findings.title: Scheduler Ignores Compiled Graph-Level ConflictConstraints
findings.description: selectReadyWaveV2 evaluates artifact readiness but completely ignores ConflictConstraint records in GraphRevision, allowing conflicting nodes to run in parallel waves.
findings.proposedTest: tests/scheduler-conflict-constraints.test.ts: Define ConflictConstraint between Node A and Node B, trigger wave selection, assert Node B is excluded from wave when Node A is running.
findings.remediation: Filter candidate ready nodes against active nodes using ConflictRiskAnalyzer in selectReadyWaveV2.

findings.title: Server SSE Loop Ignores Client Disconnect Signals
findings.description: The SSE event streaming route does not wire request.signal to abort background store polling, causing disconnected clients to leave background timers running on the server.
findings.proposedTest: tests/api-sse-disconnect.test.ts: Abort HTTP SSE stream, assert background event subscriber timer is cleared within 100ms.
findings.remediation: Listen to request.signal.addEventListener('abort', ...) and stop event polling loop immediately.

findings.title: Unauthenticated API Endpoints across Web Application
findings.description: All 17 API routes in apps/web accept requests without session authentication, authorization tokens, or CSRF validation.
findings.proposedTest: tests/api-auth-guards.test.ts: Send unauthenticated POST to /api/runs, assert HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
findings.remediation: Implement Next.js middleware / session check verifying session identity on all mutating routes.

findings.title: Indirect Prompt Injection via Unsanitized Repository Files
findings.description: File snippets and codebase text read by RepositoryIndexer are interpolated directly into LLM prompts without escaping delimiter tags or prompt injection filtering.
findings.proposedTest: tests/ai-prompt-injection.test.ts: Inject adversarial system prompt override in test file, verify LLM decomposer strips injection framing.
findings.remediation: Wrap user repository content in strict XML envelope tags (e.g. <user_file_content>) and sanitize matching closing tags.

findings.title: Uncapped Token Budget & Unmetered LLM API Invocations
findings.description: LLMDecomposer executes prompt completions without enforcing per-run token spending limits or checking pre-configured max token budgets.
findings.proposedTest: tests/ai-budget-limits.test.ts: Set run budget to $0.05, attempt high-token prompt, assert TokenBudgetExceededError.
findings.remediation: Track cumulative prompt and completion token usage in RunCoordinator and reject calls exceeding maxBudget.

findings.title: Ephemeral Trace Logging via InMemoryTraceStore Causes Diagnostic Data Evaporation
findings.description: Diagnostic trace events are logged into InMemoryTraceStore which is never flushed to disk, losing all diagnostic traces on process crash or restart.
findings.proposedTest: tests/trace-store-durability.test.ts: Log trace events, restart process, assert trace events are readable from disk trace store.
findings.remediation: Implement JsonlTraceStore mirroring JsonlRunEventStore to persist diagnostic telemetry durably.

findings.title: Missing Event Store Compaction and Snapshot Truncation Subsystem
findings.description: No event store compaction or snapshot log truncation exists. Long-running runs accumulate tens of thousands of JSONL events, degrading replay time linearly.
findings.proposedTest: tests/run-store-compaction.test.ts: Write 10,000 events, trigger compaction, assert event log truncated to snapshot checkpoint.
findings.remediation: Implement periodic event log compaction that truncates historical events prior to the latest verified RunSnapshot.

findings.title: Workspace Specifier Inconsistencies across Monorepo Package Manifests
findings.description: Several packages specify workspace dependencies using fixed versions (e.g. "1.0.0") instead of standard pnpm "workspace:*" protocols.
findings.proposedTest: tests/infra-workspace-deps.test.ts: Validate package.json manifests for workspace:* protocol consistency.
findings.remediation: Standardize all monorepo internal package dependencies to "workspace:*".

findings.title: Fragile UI Tests Rely on Exact File String Matching
findings.description: UI component tests read TSX source files as raw text using fs.readFileSync and assert exact substring class names, breaking whenever layout formatting changes.
findings.proposedTest: tests/ui-component-rendering.test.ts: Replace string matching with DOM/JSX component rendering tests using Testing Library.
findings.remediation: Refactor component tests to render components using React/Svelte testing library instead of regex over source files.
